unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U12: Apply implied authority,express restrictions and emergency powers

payload.title: Separate ordinary business authority from excluded acts
payload.core_explanation_md:
A partner acts as agent of the firm for its business. Implied authority covers acts done in the usual way of that kind of business, with the relevant firm-name or intention-to-bind requirements. It is not unlimited authority over every legal act. The source lists special matters such as arbitration, compromising claims, withdrawing proceedings and specified immovable-property acts that need the proper authority or applicable usage.

A restriction agreed internally must be considered together with the third party knowledge and the statutory binding rules. Emergency authority concerns acts a person of ordinary prudence would undertake to protect the firm from loss in similar circumstances. For account opening, retain the full statutory wording: the excluded act is opening an account on behalf of the firm in the partner own name; do not convert it into a blanket ban on firm bank accounts.

self_check.prompt_text: Why does a private restriction need a third-party notice analysis?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Internal restriction and external binding effect are different questions.

payload.stem_md: A usual business purchase is challenged solely because an undisclosed internal spending restriction was breached. Which facts matter to the firm external liability?

options.text_md: The ordinary-business authority and the counterparty knowledge of the restriction
options.explanation_md: Internal breach alone does not complete the external analysis.
Later disagreement does not decide the original authority.

options.text_md: Every private restriction automatically binds the world
A partner can never purchase for the firm
options.explanation_md: The agency rule permits qualifying acts.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Internal breach alone does not complete the external analysis.

payload.stem_md: A partner relies on ordinary implied authority to compromise a pending firm claim without checking any specific authority or usage. What is missing?

options.text_md: A rule that every partner can perform every legal act
The special authority analysis for a listed excluded act
options.explanation_md: Ordinary business agency is not unlimited.

options.text_md: Proof that the firm has no bank account
options.explanation_md: Account absence does not resolve compromise authority.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Ordinary business agency is not unlimited.
